segments.text: You keep asking what life is supposed to mean. Frankl says you've got it backwards. Life is the one asking you.
Every situation is a question put to you. And your answer isn't words. It's what you actually do next.
Stop demanding that life explain itself to you. Start treating today as an assignment only you can answer.
It's a small flip with big weight: not what do I want from life, but what is life asking of me, right now?
That's Man's Search for Meaning. Honest verdict on the channel.
